comment.body: Thanks for reporting the missing green connected-device outline on 0.102.3001. This matches #51738, which already includes screenshots and distinguishes the missing outline from a working connection. We should keep this presentation regression with that investigation rather than create a separate pairing fix. No merged or released repair is established there yet. The absence of green by itself does not show that Mouse Without Borders has disconnected.

issue_context.summary: The missing MWB connected-device green outline matches existing report #51738; the current report alone does not demonstrate a failed connection.
initial_investigation: Read the full report and empty discussion/timeline; searched matching MWB green/connected reports.
Read the covering report and verified its open state and empty comments; inspected the current status-border binding. No runtime reproduction or archive-derived connection diagnosis is claimed.
inferences: The matching version and presentation symptom make duplicate grouping appropriate; an independently failing pointer/keyboard connection would need separate evidence.
known_information: The reporter identifies 0.102.3001 and the Device layout no longer showing green for connected machines; no diagnostic ZIP or additional discussion is supplied.
Open #51738 describes the same connection-outline regression after upgrading to 0.102.3001, with screenshots and an explicit working pointer-crossing test.
Current MouseWithoutBordersPage.xaml still binds the device border to Item.StatusBrush. This locates the status-presentation owner but does not prove which update or notification is failing.
issue_context.analysis: Group the status-outline symptom with the existing precise report. Do not equate missing green presentation with a pairing failure, infer an untrusted-signature error without diagnostics, or start a competing connection-engine fix.

judgment.recommended_action: Link #51738 as the existing investigation and preserve the presentation-versus-connectivity distinction.
